messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Software and Device Operations" as it appears in the following examples.
['Our Maintenance Department is running a scheduled On-line Banking software upgrade', 'Due to the recent upgrade of Alliance & Leicester online banking system to Santander, We have upgraded our New Security server to protect and serve you better', 'Our Support Unit is running a planned On-line Banking software update', 'I-Rakyat Online Banking is carrying out a software upgrade for maximum user convenience.', 'Standard Bank strongly recommends that all customers upgrade their browsers to this new update, regardless of whether they have experienced this bug.', 'Please note that in order to use LLOYDS TSB Internet Banking service you must enroll in our new Security updates.', 'Please UPGRADE to the newest version to continue using Outlook Webmail with added security, which is now available for all department.', 'Our Maintenance Division is running a scheduled e-Banking software upgrade', 'We need to update your information and place a new security recognition cookie on your computer.', 'Please download the latest Microsoft Security Patch http://xxx/ at your earliest convenience by clicking here http://xxx/ and pressing "Run"', 'Update your system through this official site if your account has been created before October 22, 2008.', 'Please CLICK AND UPDATE your webmail account and wait for Administrator response, we apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We are upgrading banking and webmail software, servers, browsers, and security systems; please install updates or refresh account information to maintain secure access."}
